prompts: Show my Todoist tasks that are due today or overdue.
Add a task to call the accountant next Monday at 10am.
Move my overdue tasks to tomorrow.
Summarize the tasks I completed this week.
requirements: A Todoist account. Sign-in asks for Todoist's data:read_write scope: read and write access to tasks, projects, labels and filters.
limitations: This app is not created by, affiliated with, or supported by Todoist. It connects to Todoist's own MCP server.
Access covers every project the signed-in account can open. Todoist sign-in cannot limit it to one project.
Workspace projects the account hasn't joined appear by name only. Their tasks can't be read until the account joins the project.
This app does not start automatic monitoring from its MCP connection alone.
